name: sonzai-sdk
description: Three skills for Sonzai SDK developers: (1) sonzai-sdk — wizard-driven, prescribes archetype + memory mode + runtime mode (full-chat vs memory-layer) + capabilities, drives spec → review → plan. (2) full-auto — autonomous closed-loop: takes a meeting transcript, dispatches a builder subagent, exercises the built app (API + UI), feeds failures back until it works. (3) sonzai-internal-staff — gated extension for Sonzai staff dogfooding. Covers 7 archetypes, 20+ feature references, 11 decision aids (runtime-mode is the newest), 9 migration playbooks. BYOK is the recommended production posture.
